rows: Ruth bears Obed; Boaz is his father.
A new individual enters through a defined generative relationship.
An existing participant acquires a new functional relationship to the child.
The neighbors attribute a son to Naomi.
The child is associated with an additional household or beneficiary relationship-not another biological-generation event.
Boaz acts to preserve the deceased Mahlon's name in his inheritance.
Name-line continuity and biological descent must remain separate variables.
Obed subsequently fathers Jesse, who fathers David.
The new descendant continues the recorded lineage into the next passage.
